answers.question: How long do AI providers retain our data?
answers.answer: Our AI providers keep prompts and outputs for at most 30 days.

endpoints.quote: Conversation content (your prompts and Claude's outputs) is not retained by default; the exception is Covered Models, which require 30-day retention.

answers.question: Do you have zero data retention with your AI providers?
answers.answer: Yes. We use zero data retention with our AI providers. Exception: nightly digests (/api/digest) use Anthropic Message Batches, kept up to 29 days.
